The calculation for the infinite integrals in the expression was simplified. The infinite integrals was converted to Watson infinite integrals by expanding the exponential function in series, so the known higher-order Neumann function and Struve function could be used to express the Watson infinite function, thus the numerical calculation problem for the mutual inductance between the underground power cable and the underground telecommunication cable is solved. The approximate expression which was more convenient to calculate could also be obtained, if the higher-order Neumann function, the first and the second item of expanded Struve function is fetched.

articleTitle: The information modeling and communication mapping implementation of merging unit based on electronic transformer
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The realization of the process bus communications based on IEC61850 9–2 is introduced in this paper. With employing the bay-oriented principle of the IEC61850 9–2, the merging unit model is built for the transformer differential protection. The proposed merging model not only supports the broadcast / multicast and unicast transmission services of the SV message, but also supports the access of the relevant sampling control block. The entire substation configuration process is based on the processing and transferring of the SCL document. To achieve the interoperability, the merging unit model has been designed with the capability of the SCL identification and data generation. Some typical research object is analyzed and the main issue in the merging unit application based on IEC61850 is researched in detail, which has great significance to the engineering practice.

articleTitle: Monitoring and diagnostic techniques of power transformer solid insulation
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper monitoring and diagnosis methods of solid insulation in power transformer are presented, including their features and applications. In actual application, not only reliability but also economic performance of each method should be considered in response to practice situation. If economic interest and safe reliability are combined into optimal effect, various schemes may be adopted according to actual conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation of line surge arresters for lightning protection in 10kV transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper presents the line surge arrester and its principle, as well as the modeling of 10 kV transmission lines including line surge arresters. Cases with different numbers of arresters are simulated and analyzed by the electromagnetic transient program PSCAD/EMTDC. Simulation results show that installing line surge arresters can evidently reduce the surge current and overvoltage in the lines. It is an economical and effective way to reconstruct the lightning-prone sections and phases of the 10 kV lines with proper numbers of line surge arresters.

articleTitle: Computation of a kind of electric field distribution of 10kV composite insulator coated by ice
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, based on a kind of 10kV composite insulator computation model and by means of finite element method, the electric field distribution magnitude of composite insulator coated by different icicle length has been calculated, respectively under icing and de-icing condition. And it could be found that nether in icing or ice-melting condition, the max magnitude of electric fields around composite insulator coated by ice have little changed. Moreover, the electric field strength around the icicle increases along with the increasing of the length of icicle. Compared to the results under freezing state, at the ice-melting state, the electric field distortion nearby the icicle tip will be even more serious. In the end, several useful measures about how to improve the electric performance of composite insulators coated by ice have been summed up.

articleTitle: Research on temperature measurement of electrical equipment based on bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper introduced fiber grating component and its application as temperature measuring system in Tianjing Power systems. The system is different from other fiber temperature measuring system, due to its stable and reliable measurement, and cost-effectiveness. Fiber silicon rubber insulator was invented to solve the problem of fiber working-frequency withstand voltage and atmospheric over-voltage, which then overcame the difficulty of temperature monitoring in enclosed switch cabinet. It also introduced the installation, operation as well as market potential of the system.

articleTitle: A research in the supply approach of central city of the typical characteristics
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With China's rapid economic development, there is a new trend, which is symbolized as rural urbanization and urbanization of towns. Shanghai as the first representative of the cities is gradually entering the ranks of the international metropolis. How to acclimatize themselves to this new trend has become a big problem faced with all power supply companies. In order to support urbanization of the electricity needs, urbanization electricity load characteristics, the paper concludes the mature experience of Shanghai in the area of power supply. A research, which is made in the control area of Hunan power supply branch smepc, is done to investigate the existing regional electricity demand and supply approach of central city of the typical characteristics. These regions include Jinjiang commercial region, south Taipingqiao residential region, north Taipingqiao commercial and entertainment region, etc. Based on the Index System of the State Grid Corporation's “strong grid”, the typical urban centers City Power Index System and the typical forms of power supply are proposed, as a reference for high-end power supply for future cities.

Author Keywords: city centre typical regional power supply

articleTitle: Provides power quality enhancement scheme according to the different customer demand
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The deployment of a large amount of electrical equipment in modern society not only impacts the grids but also causes a higher demand of power quality. The electrical companies haven't set up management system correspond to electrical load in the customer side. And each customer improves his power quality in his own way. All these cause the low power quality of the entire grid. To these problems, the electrical companies improve operation processes, and check the electrical load conditions in the customer side when they apply for power supply, then recommend customers various methods to improve power quality according to these conditions. In addition, in order to respond to the requirement of national energy saving development and the reduction of circuit waste, we may report the monitoring of power quality to the management and the government. And keep the power quality of the entire grid controllable and in control by administrative and economic methods.

articleTitle: Dispatch emulating system based power communication network management system
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper introduces a new communication network management system that based a unified platform and lists its function models using figures. In order to meet the power communication dispatching need for emulating system, it illuminates the design principles, according that the project design and system functions of building network emulating system were come into being on base of this unified platform. Then parameter specifications and running results were obtained according to applications used in power communication system.

articleTitle: Feasibility study on replacement of Shell Diala oil by Kelamayi EHV Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: According to ASTM and DIN international standard and other equivalent GB standards, we finished a lot of experiments on physical chemical properties and electric performance of EHV transformer oil. Based on the experiments data, Kelamayi EHV Transformer Oils are compared with SHELL Diala oil used by EHV Power Transmission Co. Aiming at the special characteristics of EHV Transformer Oils, oil-flow electrification is first proposed as an evaluation index for EHV Transformer Oils replaced by domestically made oils in China. The experiment data is shown in Table 1 below. This paper researches into the most important properties of these six EHV oils. Such as kinematic viscosity, solidification point, Dielectric breakdown voltage, Dissipation factor, volume resistivity, Particle count, Oxidation stability and gassing tendency, Oxidation inhibitor content by mass. Domestic Kelamayi oils, which typed KI50AX and KI50GX are blended with SHELL Diala oil in different ratios to carry out mixed oils experiments. Research results show that Kelamayi EHV Transformer Oils which named KI50AX and KI50GX are superior to SHELL Diala oil in general properties. These two domestic made EHV transformer oils can be used in HVDC converter transformer and can be blended with SHELL Diala oil in any ratios.

articleTitle: Application of adaptive theory in distribution network protective relaying
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The paper analyses in detail the application of the adaptive theory in line protection, motor protection and etc of power distribution network. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) technology and Multi-agent technology has also made its application in adaptive protection. Using such adaptive protection technology to improve the defects of traditional protection system can make the protection system better: more reliable, sensitive and rapid. Based on analysis of its application in power distribution network, the paper puts forward the future of adaptive protective relaying

articleTitle: Research on system of combined cooling, heat and power connected into power grid
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP) production system by natural gas is the main form of distributed generation (DG). Some demonstration projects had come into operation isolated in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong. Combining with a demonstration project which capacity is 1560 kW in Beijing, the technical conditions of CCHP connected into power grid were discussed. The scheme of CCHP connected into the primary circuit, and the secondary system scheme of line protection, telecontrol, metering, communication scheme and etc was put forward. Some policy suggestion also was put forward according to the current situation that obstacles of CCHP connected into power grid has been existed in China.

articleTitle: Analysis and treatment of transformer faults caused by corrosive sulfur
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Based on electrical and chemical analysis in oils of some fault transformers in Shenzhen, it indicates that the corrosive sulfur contained in insulating oils may cause faults. Corrosive sulfur would react to copper wire and engender Cu2S during the operation of transformer. Because of the electric characteristic of Cu2S, this substance will penetrate and pollute insulating paper of the wire, and then weaken the insulation intensity. At last it would wear out coil insulation. Experiments indicate that adding passivator to insulating oil is an effective method to solve the problem. Passivator can form a protection layer on the surface of copper, which can avoid copper corrupting and can stop copper deposition in the presence of potentially corrosive sulfur compounds as well.

articleTitle: Development of a new power quality monitoring terminal based on configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the increase of the non-liner power loads and impact loads in power systems, the pollution of power quality is becoming more serious. It is important to put up multi-dimensional monitoring and construct monitoring network. In this paper the hardware and software scheme of a new power quality monitoring terminal based on configuration software is introduced in detail, which is applied to different kinds of fields and can carry out samples and data analysis of various parameters of power quality quickly and precisely. It has powerful functions, easy and flexible to be controlled, operated stably, small size and decrease the investment obviously.

articleTitle: Status-based Maintenance and its application in EAM
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: As the market environment has been changed by power system reform, power supply enterprises have to improve their management efficiency to reduce cost. Equipment maintenance management was a problem of pure technology. And now it is being transformed into a balance of cost and benefit. In this paper a method called status-based maintenance (SBM) is proposed, and it helps to make plans of equipment maintenance by comprehensive assessment of equipments. Considering equipment basic information, real-time status, investment cost, maintenance cost, fault losses, and other factors, risk analysis and profit analysis of equipment are carried out. Furthermore, SBM is applied into enterprise asset management (EAM) system. This helps to introduce advanced management ideas and scientific methods, and make the power equipment maintenance more reasonable and scientific.

articleTitle: A method of reactive power compensation dispatch based on matrix superposition theorem
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the development of power systems, the structure of power grid has become much complicated. The electrical contacts among the nodes of the system are much tight than ever before. Hence, the coupling relationships of reactive power compensation capacity among nodes can not be ignored. It will contribute to proper dispatch of the reactive resource in power grid that analyzing the relationships of the compensation devices by coordinated control. This paper gives a method to gain a reasonable control strategy of compensators and low the control times of compensators based on matrix superposition theorem. It also proves the coupling connections of the voltage and reactive power which depends on electrical parameters and the structure of power grids. The simulation of IEEE 39-bus test system demonstrates that the proposed method can meet the local compensation demand and is valuable in coordinated compensation dispatch in the grid.

articleTitle: Feeder Automation modeling in IEC61850
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Feeder Automation is one important part of distribution automation. Considering frequent change of network due to rapid growing of system, it is necessary to find a high efficient configuration way. Open and interoperability feature of IEC61850 makes it possible to model the feeder automation in IEC61850. This paper introduced the modeling of FA in IEC61850, including architecture, data, topology and communication. This paper summarized advantage and disadvantage of FA modeling in IEC61850, analyzed the requirement of FA, e.g. network topology, capacity of switch and so on, and gave some points on how to extend the IEC61850 for basic FA application. This paper concluded that FA modeling in IEC61850 is a good attempt for FA engineering with right extension.

articleTitle: A long-term energy purchasing model of distribution company in power market with DG and multi-types contracts
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper proposed an optimization long-term energy purchasing model of a distribution company (Disco) in transmission and distribution separated power market based on pool and financial bilateral contracts. Additionally there are some distributed generations (DG) in the power systems. Thus, the Disco purchases electricity energy according to the offers of DG units, Pool and several types bilateral contracts. In order to minimize its electricity purchasing cost, the Disco should determine the amount of energy bought from different electricity sources. The novel contribution of this paper is the bilateral contract considered be multiple types and every type contract framework in the purchasing model is flexible enough to accommodate many real-world bilateral electricity agreements.

Author Keywords: transmission and distribution separated power market

articleTitle: Approach about the maintaining mode for distribution automation in city
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This article summarizes the functions and features of the distribution network automation system in Jinan area, analysis the operation and maintenance mode, the current situation and problems of Jinan distribution network automation system. With the maintenance experience of the distribution network automation system, submits the suggestion to large Distribution automation system design and maintenance in ordinary city.

articleTitle: The study on voltage regulation in Central China Power Grid to suit huge power transmitted Southward through UHV project
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Voltage and reactive power regulation capability of Central China Power Grid is study in the paper when huge power is transmitted Southward through UHV project which will be built in near future. At first, the basic condition of UHV and problem of voltage and reactive power when huge power is transmitted Southward through UHV project are introduced and studied. Then, all voltage regulation methods including Nanyang transformer in plan are analyzed to solve low voltage problem of Nanyang UHV station which caused by huge power transmission. Finally, several advices are brought forward to solve low voltage problem of Nanyang UHV station which caused by huge power transmission.

articleTitle: Cellular network based wireless video surveillance system for substation
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the rapid developing of the 2.5G/3G cellular mobile communication network and the increasing of its bandwidth, the wireless video information transmission can be achieved by using the public cellular network. This makes it possible to provide low-cost wireless video surveillance system for the distribution electric power substations. Based on the embedded high performance digital media processor platform, one low-cost wireless video surveillance system is developed in this paper, which is used for the substation to implement the wireless visual monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on the control strategy of the transformer-isolated multilevel H-bridges DSTATCOM for three-phase unbalanced load compensation
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A novel control strategy is proposed based on topology of transformer-isolated multilevel H-bridge inverter for DSTATCOM. Rotating coordinate transformation is used to determine the compensation currents for unbalanced load. A control method of single-phase instantaneous reactive power theory is designed to improve the dynamic response speed of DSTATCOM. According to the structural characteristics of the main circuit of inverter, a technique of carrier phase-shifting PWM is put forward to eliminate harmonic. Finally, the simulation results show that the validity of the proposed control strategy, this method can be applied to compensate power quality problems in three-phase three-wire system.

articleTitle: Development and application project of 10kV closed circuit fuse appliance exchange without power-off
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Reliability of power supply is one of the major indexes for a power supply enterprise to establish an international first-class company and it is discovered via statistics and analysis that defect handling of 10 KV fuse appliance is an important factor that affects the reliability of power supply from distribution network to users. In order to ensure the safe operation of distribution network and to improve power supply reliability, Jinshan Power Supply Branch has developed a technology for exchanging 10 KV closed circuit fuse appliance without power-off and has achieved good result after hard working and actual application for more than one month. This technology has successfully passed the appraisal conducted by the Live Line Work Development Co., Ltd. of Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company before March 29, 2007 and Jinshan Power Supply Branch becomes the first company possessing such an appraised technology within Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic compatibility design of power field service terminal
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In this paper, many kinds of electromagnetic interference radiation sources of power field service terminal are analyzed. When each module of terminal is designed, electromagnetic compatibility is considered, requirements of test standards and the experience of practical solutions in the course of Electro Magnetic Compatibility (EMC) design, some effective methods to restrain Electro Magnetic Interference (EMI), such as surge, electrical fast transient burst and electro static discharge (ESD), are discussed in detail, combined the testing results. The results show that the design and anti-interference measures presented are easy and effective. Electromagnetic compatibility of terminal is improved overall.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of operating status for power transformer based on extension strategy generating system
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Power transformer is a complicated system due to its stochastic, fuzzy and alterable behavior. It is a decision-making problem of engineering system to assess transformer behavior. Qualitative knowledge and quantitative data need to be integrated. Quantitative change and qualitative change all need be reflected in the assessment results of transformer behavior. The behavior of whole transformer system need also be assessed by combination of different items. A method integrating quantitative and qualitative information need be used to assess transformer behavior. Extension theory is used generally to solve the inconsistent problems. A matter element consisted of research object, evaluation index, normalized value. According to rhombic thinking mode and the extension of matter element, the multi-index and hierarchical system of transformer behavior evaluation was built. Matter-element model was constructed to assess transformer behavior by matter-element transform. Three-dimensional evaluation for the behavior of whole transformer system can be implemented by quantitative, qualitative description and their change with time.

articleTitle: Physical efficiency identification and quantization method study of power transmission and transformation projects
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Physical efficiency identification and quantization of power transmission and transformation is the importance to economic evaluation and post-evaluation for projects of benefit analysis. According to kinds of project features and its position and action in the network, this paper has identified correlative physics efficiency separately. According to the main physical efficiency index of different projects, this paper has supplied the corresponding quantization calculation method based on the network features of power transmission and transformation projects, using the power system balance analysis method and looking the projects which in the power network as the study object. This method has been better applied into the economic benefit analysis of San-Xia project post-evaluation and others projects.

articleTitle: 110kV's transmission line thunderbolt simulated trial research
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Most power transmission lines pass the mountain areas in the city of ChiZhou, in these particular districts, thunders and lightning happen frequently. The rate of line jumping caused by thunderbolt in 110 kV's transmission line increases rapidly. In this paper, simulations in laboratory are done. Firstly, a lighting strikes trial model of 110 kV transmission line is built, then transmission line thunderbolt simulated trial course is analyzed including the flashover trial surveyed in the imitation field, the trial of side direction lightning rod effect verified, the influence of couple ground wire to the flashover verified, the experiment of the shaft tower counterattacking imitated and the trial of the insulation cooperated. The simulations give the scientific policy decision to the comprehensiveness lightning protection measure.

articleTitle: Application of PD measurement system for high voltage XLPE cable
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The paper introduced a kind of partial discharge (PD) measuring system for high voltage cables and its application in Beijing. The PD Check developed by TechImp Co. realized the separation and identification of discharge pulse. Whole pulses was taken in using a high-speed broad band sampling system at first, then discharge pulses were separated from noises by character which was calculated from pulses, and discharge types were ascertained at last. Tests in lab and fieldwork show that this system can effectively and accurately detect insulation flaws in the electric devices.

articleTitle: Safety control model of wind farm's integrate operation with distributed constraint conditions
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Companied by wind power generation scale enlargement, the demand for system safety is increasing. In order to stop incorrect command from threatening the stability of both wind farm and power grid as a whole, a integrate safety control mechanism, which is based on distributing constraint conditions, is proposed in this paper; implement methods for different models are presented, together with a integrate safety control model.

articleTitle: Situation and analysis of sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) byproducts of gas insulated switchgear (220kV and above) in Guangdong Province and latent fault judgment of the electric equipment
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In the occurrence of arcs discharges, spark discharges and corona discharges, sulfur hexafluoride (SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>) would be decomposed to complicated byproducts such as sulfur dioxide (SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), carbon tetrafluoride (CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>), etc. Analyzing the concentrations of these byproducts, which can be determined when the electric equipment is electriferous, is an effective method to judge the internal condition of GIS. The fault of GIS and the position of the fault can be known by SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> byproducts analysis. There are many cases about how to judge the electric equipment faults by analyzing SF6 byproducts, but with little experience about how to judge the latent faults. The article concluded the concentrations of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> byproducts in 74 220 kV and 500 kV GIS transformer substation (3770 gas chambers in total) in Guangdong province. The concentrations of carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4,</sub> thionyl sulfide (SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), sulfuryl fluoride (SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), disulfuryl decafluoride (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>OF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>), SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and sulfureted hydrogen (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S) were in partial normal distribution. The concentrations of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>OF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> were all below 0.1% (v/v); the concentrations of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were below 3muL/L; the concentrations of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S were below 1muL/L. The SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> byproducts concentrations in 500 kV GIS were lower than those in 220 kV GIS. The SF6 byproducts concentrations were higher in GIS that have been operating longer.

articleTitle: A method of reducing the attrition rate of 110kV arrester base-plate isolator
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Some 110 kV arrester base-plate isolator in the 110 kV electric substation dominated by power transformation Dept.1, Foshan power supply bureau, burst frequently in the last years. The most serious one ruptured just working three months. This paper talks about the cause of disruption, the settlement and the effect of crack control.

articleTitle: Research on islanding detection method for PV power system based on chaos theory
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: The occurrence cause and negative effects of the islanding are presented in the paper, and a new method is presented based on chaos system. This paper applies certain chaos system of its sensitivity to periodical voltage signal to make its periodical solution yield a dramatic change to detect islanding, existence of the islanding can be identified by discriminating operation status of chaos system. The proposed method is showed to have fast acting and little influence on power quality. The simulations of the proposed method are carried out according to IEEE Std 1547-2003, the simulation results verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: The application of compound networks in fault diagnosis of power transformer
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Using the concepts of typical gas's concentration and cumulative frequency in analysis of the reliability data for dealing with the pretreatment of data of DGA, two new normalized methods which named characteristic normalization and mix normalization are presented in this paper. The Fisher rule to evaluate the results of the two pretreatment methods is also introduced. The evaluation of the results indicates that both of the two data pretreatment methods can achieve the purpose of big difference in the value of mean between classes and small difference in dispersion of a class. The DGA data of the failure transformers are treated by different normalization methods as the training samples, and then the samples are trained in the compound neural networks which use the CP algorithm. The diagnosis results of the test samples indicate that the new methods may help to improve the precision of network diagnosis.

articleTitle: Investigation on earthing of low-voltage Grid
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper deals with the investigation on the status quo of power supply and distribution of the low-voltage grid, this paper, through the investigation, clarify the objective causes of the earthing faults and intentions of the manual earthing (mainly neutral-point earthing), analyze the electric characteristics of two modes of earthing, point out the dangers of the earthing of the power grid, find out the fundamental causes of the failure of creepage protector for the residual current, unveil a huge shared geo-electric system consisted of many manual earthing and fault earthing, and probe into the possible consequences of the two modes of earthing that universally exist; in addition, the authors put forward a new thought that can guarantee the grid to be operated in the air and cleaned independently so as to supply power economically, safely, steadily and cleanly after releasing the manual earthing, monitoring system and fault earthing thereof.

Author Keywords: earthing of one grid through different leads

articleTitle: Stochastic non-linear Nash Game in multi-zone electricity markets
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: A stochastic non-linear Nash game for all the players in multi-zone supply auctions is established in this paper. The bidding strategies of power suppliers in multi-zone energy markets are functions of their own generation costs as well as the bidding behaviors of their competitors. The effects of the uncertainty and the risk are considered in constructing the bid functions of power suppliers. Physical constraints of multi-zone power systems are considered in the model. Dynamic programming algorithm is used to solve the Nash Game problem. A simplified three-zone model is used as a case study. The numerical outcome shows that our model is feasible and applicable.

articleTitle: The discussion of rising voltage to 20kV in urban distribution network
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: With the city's power load density increasing, 20 kV distribution network become a trend in medium voltage distribution network. From the viewpoint of power network planning, through comparative analyzing indexes, such as voltage degree, short circuit capacity, substation capacity, line corridors and substation layout, land occupation, investment costs, technical and economic indicators of the distribution network and so on, the influence of 20 kV medium voltage distribution network to power network planning is discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on Price's optimization model of distribution market based on value chain theory
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Under the market circumstance, the price of distribution market is of dynamic change. Generally, the price fluctuation begins from some regions and links, and then disperses to other regions and links, which is realized by price conduction mechanism. The conduction impetus comes from the differences of price among different regions and links. In order to judge whether the distribution market price is reasonable or not, it should be analyzed from the whole course of entire power industry links instead of only some link. Distribution market is connected with the generation market or transmission market and users, with the duality of monopoly and competition. So, according to this feature, analyses the business types of distribution market and distinguishes between monopoly business and competition business. Then based on the value chain theory, this paper analyzes influencing factors and formation mechanism of distribution market price from every link of electricity industry chain, including generation, transmission, distribution and sale. The price model for future distribution market of our country is explored, pricing methods and optimization models are presented. At last, some proposals for the future market's price mechanism are put forward.

articleTitle: Domestic demand side management for increasing the value of wind
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper compares and contrasts the benefits from dynamic and non-dynamic demand management schemes in domestic sector for more effective wind power utilization. Non-dynamic demand management by shifting the demand from peak periods to off peak periods mitigates the issues associated with demand variations. In dynamic demand management, load by responding to wind generation output's variations will lessen the intermittency issues of wind power. The paper first presents a general overview of these two technologies, evaluates their benefits and by further expanding the subject to a test system with intermittent generation, it demonstrates the impact of the dynamic demand side management.

articleTitle: The examination and judgment of SF6 Electrical Equipment discharge failure
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This article analyzes two types of SF6 Electrical Equipment discharge failure: Hard Failure (the discharge channel mainly consists by SF6 gas insulator only. Electric Insulation beyond retrieve after high energy discharge) and Soft Failure (the discharge channel mainly consists by SF6 gas insulator only or with solid insulator, Electric Insulation can be retrieved after high energy discharge); Determine a field fast method to detect the main characteristic gas SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S caused by SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> Electrical Equipment Discharge Failure; Expatiated on the standard of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> Electrical Equipment Discharge Failure and its application, according to which types positions and current of discharge could be determined.

articleTitle: Argumentation of management in electric power require- ment, Government agency energy-saving, avoid the rush time
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: In allusion to china's current strategic of advocating conservation-oriented society, we use the formula to calculate the supplier and requirement's benefit of energy-saving from lighting and power energy, in order for judging the effectiveness of management and establishing the assessment system of energy-saving. The argumentation of increasing the efficiency with which we use energy can make corporation of power supply and consumer benefit from energy-saving. The government agency saving energy is the inexorable requirements for developing resource-conserving society. The emphasis of government agency energy-saving is air-condition, heatings lighting and office equipment in the building. We must establish the management system of power energy, invest necessary fund and technology, formulate the plan, establish the examination and report system. Today the electric power price in rush time is different from the other time. It cushions consumer, corporation of power supply and power plant from the effect of power supply.

articleTitle: The exploration and study of marketing management strategy in electricity enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: Starting from the guideline of marketing management in electricity enterprises, this paper describes comprehensively how to expand electricity market in the strategy aspect and the necessity to improve the marketing management level. In the new situation, this paper has deeply explored and researched the implementing procedure of electricity marketing strategy, submitted special solution to improve the implementation of electricity marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Anqing to the development of solar thermal power generation industry
publicationTitle: 2008 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution
abstract: This paper initial on the solar parabolic trough collectors, compact Fresnel linear reflector (CLFR). And they in the integration of fossil-fired power plant Kirchmoser (Germany) Staudinger5 (Germany) Stanwell (Australia) etc., of the application, and China development of solar energy, analyses the possibility, necessity and feasibility of the development of solar energy in Anqing. Seizing the opportunity, to strive for integration of solar energy coal-fired power plant project register. Promote the development of Anqing.

Author Keywords: solar energy integration of fuel-fired power plant
